An analysis of the training examples reveals the following transformation rule:

1. Identify the contiguous band of completely empty lines (all zeros), which can be either horizontal (full empty rows) or vertical (full empty columns).
2. Fill this band with color `3` (green), leaving a 1-pixel margin of zeros on both outer borders of the band (i.e., the first and last line of the empty band remain `0`).
